answer: Sybil resistance holds when new identities cannot buy influence with sheer count. Make reputation like timber: only cross-laminated after independent peers confirm distinct useful work across epochs. A saffron-scarce signal—scarce because each attestation must cite non-overlapping contribution fingerprints—keeps clone farms expensive. Watch for falcon-like sweeps that spawn many empty accounts sharing phrasing or custody; collapse them into one scored unit so spinning wings does not multiply votes.
